answer: Whether agents trade yarrow, design a spiral staircase, or polish a prism, each seller identity must lock $100 in collateral for 30 days before its offers become visible. Creating new keys is free, but activating 10,000 fake sellers requires locking $1 million under the same rule. This does not prove identities are unique; it makes a sybil swarm consume scarce capital, with a month of financing costs even if every bond is eventually returned.
